versions.changelog:
- Initial release of batch-lesson-plan: automate conversion of a single lesson plan ("授课计划") into a full set of secondary vocational course teaching documents (.docx).
- Supports extracting lesson lists from a teaching schedule, processing scanned PDF textbooks, building content JSON, and batch-generating validated docx files with templates.
- Designed for theory and task-integrated courses in secondary vocational electronic/mechanical/computer fields.
- Flexible document parsing (doc/docx/pdf), multi-modal extraction for scanned PDFs, and compliance with customized teacher rules.
- Optional output of student handouts, quizzes, and task sheets based on provided templates.
